title: The Fake Yearbook
author: D. M. Zhou
blurb: Silas Fairweather, a coder whose anonymous account knows too much, has spent five years being so careful it hurts. But when a group chat starts predicting things that haven't happened yet, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must expose what the school board buried, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
